findings.finding: Top-left caption zone is busy and lacks clean negative space.
findings.visible_evidence: The top-left quadrant is occupied by a detailed window with bright dawn light and visible ship masts outside.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose or crop to leave a clear, low-detail area in the top-left for lettering: shift the window out of that quadrant or raise/crop so the top-left shows plain wall; reduce contrast/texture there while keeping dawn light across the quilt.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s hairstyle appears as a shaved-sides/mohawk rather than uniformly short black hair.
findings.visible_evidence: The sleeper’s hair is closely shorn on the sides with a raised central strip.
findings.repair_prompt: Adjust Queequeg’s hair to short, even black hair without shaved sides to align with the described look.

findings.finding: Reserved bottom-left caption zone is busy with patterned quilt and Ishmael’s forearm/hand, leaving no clean negative space for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: Bottom-left corner contains high-contrast patchwork squares and Ishmael’s hand gripping the quilt.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose or clear the bottom-left: move Ishmael’s hand and quilt upward/right, and simplify that corner with plain bedding or a soft vignette so a clean light-toned rectangle remains for the caption.

findings.finding: The tomahawk-pipe reads as a real hatchet rather than a smoking pipe.
findings.visible_evidence: A metal axe head on a thick wooden handle lies on the bed with no visible pipe bowl or mouthpiece; proportions match a small hatchet.
findings.repair_prompt: Redesign the tomahawk-pipe to clearly be a pipe: smaller overall, hatchet-shaped head incorporating a visible bowl, a slender wooden stem ending in a mouthpiece; avoid heavy axe proportions.

findings.finding: Ishmael’s mid-gesture reach to rouse Queequeg is not depicted.
findings.visible_evidence: One hand pulls the quilt and the other touches Ishmael’s neck; no hand reaching toward Queequeg.
findings.repair_prompt: Pose Ishmael with one hand extending toward Queequeg’s shoulder or arm while the other throws the quilt aside, keeping Queequeg asleep.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s self-shake and arm withdrawal are not clearly depicted.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg is upright and staring with one hand on the mattress and the other on the bedding; there are no motion cues or posture indicating a vigorous shake or a distinct arm-withdrawing gesture.
findings.repair_prompt: Repose Queequeg mid-shake with subtle motion blur or repeated-contour lines at the shoulders/head and forearms, and show his near arm pulling back from Ishmael. Keep the two-shot at the bed edge with Ishmael propped up mid-expostulation, the patchwork counterpane visible, and preserve clear negative space at the top-center for the caption.

findings.finding: Shot is not clearly from Ishmael’s POV as specified.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael is fully visible reclining on the left side of the frame while looking at Queequeg, indicating a third-person angle rather than a POV shot.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose to a medium over-the-blanket POV from Ishmael’s vantage so Ishmael is not fully visible (at most a foreground edge of quilt/hand). Keep Queequeg mid-frame gesturing toward the clothes pile and the open door. Preserve the patchwork counterpane in the foreground and maintain clean negative space in the bottom-right for the caption. No readable text.

findings.finding: Boots depicted as modern lace-up footwear rather than pull-on cowhide boots.
findings.visible_evidence: A pair of ankle-high lace-up boots sit on the floor beneath the chair by the washstand.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the lace-up boots with damp, wrinkled brown pull-on cowhide boots with no laces; keep them positioned by the chair.

findings.finding: Hard soap bar is not visible on or near the washstand.
findings.visible_evidence: The washstand surface shows a basin, pitcher, and towel, but no small off-white rectangular bar of soap.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a small off-white rectangular hard soap bar on the washstand near the basin; ensure it reads clearly but subtly.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s hair appears tied into a mid-length bun rather than short hair as specified.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg is shown with hair gathered into a noticeable bun at the back of his head.
findings.repair_prompt: Shorten Queequeg’s hair to a clearly short length (or a very small topknot) consistent with his description; retain tattoos and overall look.

findings.finding: Bottom-center area is somewhat busy due to the patterned quilt and floor texture, reducing clean space for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: The patchwork quilt and floor extend into the lower center of the frame with visible texture and color variation.
findings.repair_prompt: Introduce clearer negative space at the bottom-center (e.g., vignette fade or softened, darker plain area) to reserve a clean caption zone without covering key details.

findings.finding: Two harpoons appear: Queequeg shaves with a separate harpoon head while a fully assembled harpoon also leans against the wall, obscuring the intended detachable-stock setup.
findings.visible_evidence: A complete harpoon with steel head is propped beside the hanging coat, while Queequeg holds another steel head on a short handle to his cheek.
findings.repair_prompt: Depict only one harpoon. Show Queequeg holding the detached steel head for shaving and place the matching wooden stock clearly set aside without a head (e.g., on the washstand or leaning nearby). Remove any second full harpoon.

findings.finding: The reserved top-left caption zone is busy and lacks clean negative space.
findings.visible_evidence: Top-left contains a detailed window with curtains and an exterior harbor view plus the upper area of Ishmael and the quilt.
findings.repair_prompt: Clear the top-left by shifting or cropping the window and Ishmael down/right and leaving a plain section of wall with minimal texture for the caption.

findings.finding: Mirror appears as a framed wall mirror rather than a small mirror shard tacked to the wall.
findings.visible_evidence: A rectangular wooden-framed mirror hangs above the washstand.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the framed mirror with a small, irregular mirror shard visibly tacked to the wall above the washstand.
